title: Generate deterministic pending-sale evidence templates
guarantees: Evidence template identity is derived from the current verification queue and supporting market record instead of manual transcription.
The default task is the next pending original-marketplace sale in deterministic contribution-priority and stored-sale order.
Already verified sales are excluded from pending task selection.
Original marketplace locator fields and verified_at are blank by default, so an untouched template cannot pass evidence ingest validation.
Template generation does not mutate market records, realized sale samples, EV values or verification state.
